units.source_text: 我连对老师的憎恨也忘却了！

en.t: I had even forgotten my hatred for my teacher!

units.source_text: 我已经从母亲、朋友、所有一切事物中摆脱出来，成了自由之身。

en.t: I had already broken free from my mother, my friends, and everything else, and had become a free man.

units.source_text: 但是，我还不至于愚蠢到产生这样的错觉，

en.t: But I was not so foolish as to fall into such an illusion,

units.source_text: 以为这新的日子住着舒畅，没有必要下手就可以实现世界面貌的改变。

en.t: imagining that these new days would be pleasant to live in, and that the face of the world could be changed without my having to act.

units.source_text: 任何事情，从结尾的角度来看，都是可以宽恕的。

en.t: Anything, when seen from the standpoint of its ending, can be forgiven.

units.source_text: 我感到已经把从结尾的角度来观察事物的目光变成自己的目光，

en.t: I felt that I had already made the gaze that observes things from the standpoint of their ending into my own gaze,

units.source_text: 而且还亲自着手我断这种结尾。

en.t: and that I was personally setting my hand to severing such an ending.

units.source_text: 这正是我的自由的根据。

en.t: This was precisely the basis of my freedom.
